decisions.title: Graph-over-folders IA — edges not table names
decisions.decision: Life entities relate through edges. IA must express relationships (e.g. goal→habit→log→score) rather than forcing users to know table names or navigate as folders mirroring engineering schemas.
decisions.reason: Principle IA-1 — Graph over folders. Protects connected life-graph claim.

evidence.quote: Life entities relate through edges. IA must express relationships (goal→habit→log→score) rather than forcing users to know table names.
AIIMIN's core claim is a connected life graph. IA that mirrors engineering tables or vendor modules will recreate the fragmentation the product exists to solve.

decisions.implementation_impact: Nav/labels/entity UIs show relationships; forbid folder-tree IA that mirrors DB table names.

decisions.title: Primary IA intents: capture, review, plan, prepare, configure
decisions.decision: Primary entry points serve intents: capture, review, plan, prepare, configure. Domain nouns (Finance, Family) are valid destinations, not mandatory first gates for every utterance.

evidence.quote: Primary entry points serve intents: capture, review, plan, prepare, configure. Domain nouns (Finance, Family) are valid destinations, not mandatory first gates for every utterance.

decisions.implementation_impact: Needs destination map under each intent (closes M-001 / GOV-075 partially). Until then: reject taxonomy-first utterance gates.

decisions.title: Four IA node layers: Capture, Execution, Planning, Derived
decisions.decision: IA distinguishes four layers: Capture (fast write; minimal fields), Execution (direct action), Planning (direction first), Derived (calm read; no fake input). Do not force derived-node UI patterns onto capture nodes.
decisions.reason: Principle IA-4 — Capture nodes vs derived nodes.

sections: Principle IA-4 — Capture nodes vs derived nodes
evidence.quote: Do not force derived-node UI patterns onto capture nodes.

sections: Principle IA-4 — Capture nodes vs derived nodes — table
evidence.quote: Capture | Journal, notes, transactions, logs | Fast write; minimal fields

sections: Principle IA-4 — Capture nodes vs derived nodes — table
evidence.quote: Derived | Life Score, insights, reports | Calm read; no fake input

decisions.implementation_impact: Every entity/page declares layer; capture UIs stay minimal; derived surfaces never fake write controls.

decisions.title: User-owned masthead free-pin navigation (bounded); honest More
decisions.decision: Masthead free-pin (bounded) beats forced sidebar taxonomy sermons. Overflow is honest ("More") — do not hide essential capture behind personalization debt.
decisions.reason: Principle IA-6 — User-owned navigation. Reasoning states free-pin already locked.

evidence.quote: Masthead free-pin (bounded) beats forced sidebar taxonomy sermons. Overflow is honest ("More") — do not hide essential capture behind personalization debt.
Free-pin navigation and consolidated read surfaces are already locked decisions; principles must protect them.
Free-pin chaos without sensible defaults for new users.

decisions.implementation_impact: Implement bounded free-pin + More overflow. Needs founder defaults for new users (Known risks). Complements GOV-075; does not alone name primary destinations.

decisions.title: Consolidate read surfaces; new dashboard must kill an old one
decisions.decision: When two pages answer the same "how am I doing?" question, merge. Insights redirecting into Reports is the template. New dashboard pages require killing an old one.

evidence.quote: When two pages answer the same "how am I doing?" question, merge. Insights redirecting into Reports is the template. New dashboard pages require killing an old one.

decisions.implementation_impact: Feature intake for new dashboards must name the page killed or the merge target. Ban everything-page dumps.

decisions.title: Command Palette / universal search are first-class IA
decisions.decision: Command Palette / universal search are not power-user Easter eggs; they are the routing spine for "one utterance, many tables."
decisions.reason: Principle IA-9 — Search and palette are first-class IA.

sections: Principle IA-9 — Search and palette are first-class IA
evidence.quote: Command Palette / universal search are not power-user Easter eggs; they are the routing spine for "one utterance, many tables."

decisions.implementation_impact: Needs scope/spec (surfaces, actions, privacy). Treat palette/search as primary routing, not optional power feature.

decisions.title: Settings are a penalty box — no daily actions or junk drawer
decisions.decision: Settings hold rare preference and account risk. Do not park daily actions in Settings. Do not use Settings as a junk drawer for unfinished features.
decisions.reason: Principle IA-10 — Settings are a penalty box.

sections: Principle IA-10 — Settings are a penalty box
evidence.quote: Settings hold rare preference and account risk. Do not park daily actions in Settings. Do not use Settings as a junk drawer for unfinished features.

decisions.implementation_impact: Audit Settings for daily actions; relocate to intent surfaces. Unfinished features do not land in Settings.

decisions.title: Knowledge/Notes ≠ Journal ≠ Documents
decisions.decision: Knowledge/Notes (source-grounded reference library), Journal (reflection capture), and Documents (files/artifacts, often family/vault-linked) must remain distinct concepts in IA to prevent GoodNotes/Notion mush.

evidence.quote: IA must keep these distinct to prevent GoodNotes/Notion mush.

sections: Principle IA-11 — Knowledge ≠ Journal ≠ Documents — table
Principle IA-11 — Knowledge ≠ Journal ≠ Documents — table
Principle IA-11 — Knowledge ≠ Journal ≠ Documents — table

decisions.implementation_impact: Separate nav/routes/primitives for Notes, Journal, Documents; no unified mush editor identity.

decisions.title: Timeline/Calendar is chronology, not a social feed
decisions.decision: Timeline/Calendar surfaces organize by time for planning and memory. They must not become social feeds or infinite engagement scrolls.
decisions.reason: Principle IA-12 — Timeline is chronology, not a feed.

sections: Principle IA-12 — Timeline is chronology, not a feed
evidence.quote: Timeline/Calendar surfaces organize by time for planning and memory. They must not become social feeds or infinite engagement scrolls.

decisions.implementation_impact: Timeline/Calendar UX optimized for planning/memory; ban social-feed patterns and infinite engagement scroll goals.

decisions.title: New entities must declare IA contract (layer, write owner, edges, ceiling, blueprint)
decisions.decision: New entities must declare: capture vs derived (layer), write primitive owner, edges, device ceiling, and which page blueprint owns them.
decisions.reason: Future impact section — operationalizes IA principles for entity intake.

evidence.quote: New entities must declare: capture vs derived, write primitive owner, edges, device ceiling, and which page blueprint owns them.

decisions.implementation_impact: Add entity IA declaration checklist to feature/schema intake; reject entities missing any field.
